decisions.reason: The firm has sunk substantial engineering and public commitment into this core two-component resin injection unit, and escalation pressures make withdrawal unlikely within a year.
As a second publicly launched two-component resin injection unit, the accumulated investment and need to justify the earlier decision keep the probability of dropping low despite any soft results.
The manual airless spray gun remains tied to the firm's core spray-application identity and manufacturing commitments, so management will likely persist rather than withdraw near-term.
The multi-model air-assisted airless line is a highly visible, substantial commitment central to the firm's announced direction, making a near-term drop very unlikely under escalation logic.

Although the data logger is less central than core spray equipment, the resources invested and the public launch still generate enough escalation pressure to keep it for the coming year, albeit with a higher withdrawal risk.
